principle: Temporal, non-overlapping segments. Thresholds are derived only from CALIBRATION (label-free target flag rates). Configuration choices (gating, priority, policy) are made only on VALIDATION. TEST is evaluated once per frozen configuration and never used for tuning. Each segment carries a warm-up block used only to build trailing baselines; warm-up sols are never scored.

calibration.note: The original v0.1 development segment. It was inspected extensively while building v0.1 and is therefore treated as contaminated: used for threshold derivation and debugging only. The sol 242 SEP is reported as a DEVELOPMENT event, never as test evidence.

validation.note: Used for threshold sweeps and configuration choices. Contains the 2013-10-10 surface SEP and the first Forbush decreases of the Guo et al. (2018) catalogue.

test.note: Held out. Not inspected before the configuration was frozen. Contains the 2014-09-02 and 2014-09-10 surface SEPs, Forbush decreases from the Guo et al. (2018) catalogue, and the MY34 global dust storm onset/peak at Gale.

pds_gaps.note: No product exists on the PDS for these sols (verified by directory listing, 2026-09-24).
